ios.desc:
Limit your internet speed using this simple app.

* It's simple to use and activate in one click. You can also add and manage different speed profiles and switch between them seamlessly.

* Internet Speed Limiter lets you throttle the bandwidth of your Apple Device. Finely control download and upload speed on your device. 

* It works by creating a local VPN that intelligently throttles all your internet traffic right on the device. Because the VPN is created and runs entirely locally, no data is ever sent to any third-party server. Your connection stays completely private. 100% safe and 100% under your control.

* Real Time Internet Usage
Analyse what service / IP is using more data with live history of entire Internet Traffic going through your device.  Find out what are hidden services that use data in background. 

* Overrides - Per app, per website, and per IP limits
Identify domains / services / IP address used by certain App from real time history and group them together into one app. Then put override on that entire app for limiting its upload or download speed. 

* Shortcuts, Control Centre and Automations
Start or stop a speed profile from Control Centre, or start, stop, and switch profiles using the Shortcuts app. Trigger automatically by location (office, home, port, vessel), by time of day, or by any other Shortcut automation you already use. No need to open the app every time the network or other conditions should change. Use speed limiter smartly with complex shortcuts and automations to save even more data seamlessly.
There is also a shortcut to trigger Live Activity that shows real time speed usage.

* Live Activity on Dynamic Island and Lock Screen
Live Activity puts your real-time download and upload speed on Dynamic Island and the Lock Screen.
iOS has no built-in place that shows current internet speed while you use other apps. Only this app can pin that live rate on the Island and the lock screen, so you see usage without unlocking or opening Settings.
Glance once, know how fast the phone is running, and catch a spike before it burns through your data.

* Use Cases
Developers can use it to simulate how real word speeds affect their apps, websites and services for iOS. They can also add latency to packets to simulate users.
Seafarers, Mariners and other users for whom data is expensive and limited. 

Set a download and upload cap so streaming apps, social apps, and background updates uses less data instead of burning a prepaid SIM, roam

show_hn.title: Show HN: Internet Speed Limiter – throttle iPhone/iPad network for testing

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I just released a small iOS and iPadOS app called Internet Speed Limiter. It lets you slow down your device's entire internet connection directly on the phone or iPad. No Mac required, no Xcode Network Link Conditioner, no proxies or complicated setup.

Most of us test apps on fast Wi-Fi or strong cellular, but actual users often face slow 3G, weak signals, or bad hotel networks. This app lets you reproduce those conditions right where you are developing. You choose a profile like Slow, Medium and Fast or set your own bandwidth. Flip the switch and everything on the device, your app, Safari, whatever, starts feeling the throttle. It works through a local VPN profile so it affects the whole system.

You can find it on the App Store here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/internet-speed-limiter/id6760114671
I would love to hear questions, feedback and/or feature requests. If you give it a try and something works great or breaks badly, tell me. I am around to chat.

Thanks for reading!
Jay
